summary_md: This looks high-impact (auth/payments/sends/migrations). The lane planned it but paused for your go before doing anything. Plan: ## Plan for ARCA-61 — Saved card lists not persisting to signed-in account  **What I found before proposing anything (read-only audit, no code changed):**  I had an agent trace the full chain — `WatchlistPage.tsx` → `api.ts` → `modules/watchlist/handlers.ts` → `schema.ts` → auth/session code. The good news: the backend is *not* the obvious culprit the ticket suspected. Every layer is properly scoped to the logged-in user already: - The client never touches localStorage/sessionStorage for watchlist data — it's a clean API-only flow. - Every watchlist route requires a valid session
